entries.zh: 依从、顺随，依其意愿而行；听凭、随意
entries.en: to comply with, to follow (his will); to do as one pleases, at will

entries.zh: 诚款、诚恳；款款从容、有条不紊
entries.en: sincere, earnest; leisurely, in good order
entries.notes: 汉字栏有款/歉之疑，取款（音 cuân、上声相合，歉不合 hacer con orden 之动词义）；西语后半 smo trasporto 难辨

entries.en: to fan, to make air with the hands
entries.notes: 汉字栏樾/楓存疑，二字均不切扇风义，释义从西语短语 hacer aire con las manos

entries.zh: 制作、建造、制造；装作、做作
entries.en: to make, to construct, to fabricate; to feign, to affect
to establish, to institute, to create, to set up

entries.zh: 成婚、结为夫妻（做翁某/翁婆：结为夫妇）
entries.en: to marry, to wed, to become husband and wife
entries.notes: 西语栏严重难辨（仅 marida 等碎片可读）；成婚义从汉字做翁婆与音节 chǒàng pō 推得

entries.en: to cure, to heal (illness)
entries.notes: 西语栏整句难辨；首字有瘉/痢之疑，取瘉（痊愈）以合 hacer 系动词性词条

entries.en: to do with all one's might, to exert all one's strength

entries.zh: 顺从他的意志；阿意曲从
entries.en: to do his will; to comply with and cater to him
as he pleases, at his discretion
gentle, docile, compliant
according to one's wish, to follow one's wish
at one's pleasure, as one wishes

entries.zh: 越轨、逾越本分（犯上违命）
entries.en: to transgress, to exceed one's proper bounds (against command)
entries.notes: 西语栏难辨（似涉王命/教令 mandan）；越轨义从汉字越（越权越礼）与重复音节 vat

entries.en: to make salt, to sun-dry (brine) for salt
entries.notes: 鹽/塩为异体字之疑，不影响释义

entries.en: to make salt by boiling (brine)
entries.notes: 鹽/塩为异体字之疑，不影响释义

entries.en: to act according to reason
entries.notes: 汉字栏首字有東/查之疑（東心做难解），依理义从西语 conforme a la razón

entries.en: to change, to transform, to alter
entries.notes: 西语尾词缩作 m，疑为 mudança（变化）之截，展开依赖推断

entries.en: to act rashly, without order or restraint

entries.zh: 行事懵乱无章；懵懂乱来
entries.en: to act confusedly, without order
entries.notes: 首字有濛/妄之疑，懵乱义兼从西语 sin concierto 与音节 bông-lâng

entries.zh: 混乱地做、搀杂胡做（不分先后次序）
entries.en: to do in disorder, to mix things up haphazardly
entries.notes: 汉字摻做仅二字而音节三（lâm-lâm-chō），字音对应存出入，乱做义从西语 hacer sin concierto

entries.en: to explain, to interpret, to expound
entries.notes: M栏后二音节 T99 污损难辨，且西语 bien amparando 与汉字解釋不合，释义仅凭 cài sèg＝解釋两字
